title: The Log of the Gull's Wake

acts.title: Washed Ashore
acts.blurb: Eat, build a roof, look around, and light the signal fire.

acts.title: The Hexed Isle
acts.blurb: Something on this island keeps the ships away. Break its hold.

acts.title: The Way Home
acts.blurb: A gale, a hard season, and one friend still out on the rocks.

twists.how: After newGame, put the top card of G.ev.deck into the left threat slot (G.ev.threat[0]), so its threat effect fires when the round-2 event pushes it off.
After newGame, set G.morale to -param (morale still stays inside the normal -3..+3 track).
After the Stranded Friend scenario setup, set G.sc.ada to param, so Ada starts that many wounds down on the rock.

intro.text: Day one. The Gull's Wake broke on the reef in the night. Two of us made it to the sand.
Before anything clever: everyone eats one food each night, or takes two wounds.
Then let's gather food today and keep our hands whole. Friday and the dog will help.

outro.text: Three nights, three meals, nobody lost. The beach almost feels like a camp.

opponent.name: Gnawing Hunger
opponent.personality: Quiet and patient. It only bites at night, and only if the food pile is empty.

goal.text: Survive to the end of day 3 with everyone alive.

stars.text: Survive to the end of day 3
Take 3 wounds or fewer in all
End with at least 1 food in camp

easier.text: Same gentle island; the coach points at the food every morning.

intro.text: Day four. Rain clouds over the ridge. Sleeping in the open costs a wound every night.
Wood is everything here. Gather it, then put two of us on the Shelter to make it a sure thing.
Two pawns on one build is a sure success. One pawn rolls the dice.

outro.text: Walls and a floor. The rain can drum on it all it likes.

opponent.name: The Long Rain
opponent.personality: Grey and steady. Ruins food and wood that sits above the roof.

goal.text: Build the Shelter before the end of day 5.

stars.text: Take 4 wounds or fewer in all

easier.text: The coach reminds you to stack wood first, then build.

intro.text: Day seven. The beach is picked clean. We need to know what else this island holds.
Exploring finds new tiles with food, wood and shelter. Two tiles out costs one more pawn.
Mind the eyes in the dark. Something hunts out there, and it will notice us.

outro.text: A river, a ridge, a grove of good timber. And tracks we will not follow alone.

opponent.name: The Night Prowlers
opponent.personality: Curious and hungry. They wait at the edge of every new tile you uncover.

goal.text: Have 4 island tiles explored (3 new ones) before the end of day 6.

stars.text: Take 5 wounds or fewer in all

easier.text: The coach marks the closest unexplored space each morning.

intro.text: Day ten. A sail passed far out this morning and never turned. We need a fire they can see.
Build Fire, then stack the signal pile: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 wood, one stage a day. Fifteen in all.
Sail after sail will pass you by. I am very good at being empty.

outro.text: The ship turned. But her captain swore she'd seen grey fog wrap the island like a hand.
She took our letters and promised to return. Then she sailed. The fog came in that night.

opponent.name: The Empty Horizon
opponent.personality: Calm and vast. It never attacks; it simply lets the days run out.
opponent.taunt: Day twelve is over. Nothing on the water but me.
opponent.praise: A column of smoke, and a ship that turns. Fine. I was never yours to keep.

goal.text: Marooned: have Fire and a full 15-wood signal pile in round 10, 11 or 12.

stars.text: Take 8 wounds or fewer in all

easier.text: The coach watches the signal pile and tells you when a stage is due.

intro.text: The fog has not lifted in a week. The cook found old crosses carved into the cliff.
Every tale I know says the same: crosses on five different tiles break a curse like this.
Plant your sticks. I will sit on your best ground and make every step cost double.

outro.text: Two crosses up, and the fog thinned a hand's width. It can be beaten.

opponent.name: The Whispering Fog
opponent.personality: Sly. Book events bring fog onto tiles, and fog makes every action there cost one more pawn.

goal.text: Raise 2 crosses on different tiles before the end of day 6.

stars.text: Take 6 wounds or fewer in all

easier.text: Fewer book events (less fog), the dog joins and you start with 4 items.

intro.text: The explorer walked out of the fog this morning. She'd been lost since the wreck.
There is a temple up in the hills. Whatever holds this island, it keeps its treasures there.
Come in, come in. Pay the altar in blood, and the temple pays you back. Maybe.

outro.text: Old tools, a bell, a blade. The temple gave more than it took. This time.

opponent.name: The Altar Shadows
opponent.personality: Greedy and theatrical. Totems reveal the temple, a wounding altar and hideouts full of fog.

goal.text: Search the dark temple and raise 3 crosses before the end of day 8.

stars.text: Temple searched and 3 crosses by day 8
Take 8 wounds or fewer in all

easier.text: Fewer book events and 4 starting items.

intro.text: The soldier came down from the hideouts with a rusted musket and no memory of the last month.
Five crosses, five tiles. I'll keep the beasts off whoever is carrying the wood.
I have kept this island for a hundred years. I already took the edge of your first night.

outro.text: The fifth cross went up at dusk. The fog lifted like a curtain, and out on the reef we saw her:
Hello the shore! I've been on this rock for days. Please, a boat!

opponent.name: The Grey Shroud
opponent.personality: Old, cold and certain. It spreads fog, wakes the altar, and lets the clock do the rest.
opponent.taunt: Ten days, and still the island is mine. Lie down in the fog.
opponent.praise: Five crosses. The bell rings and I go quiet. You earned your sky.

twist.text: Boss rule: the Grey Shroud starts with an event card already in the left threat slot. It fires on day 2 unless you deal with it.

goal.text: The Hexed Isle: raise a cross on five different tiles within 10 rounds.

stars.text: Take 8 wounds or fewer in all

easier.text: No early threat, fewer book events and 4 starting items.

intro.text: Ada is alive out there, but no raft of ours would survive the autumn sea. We signal again.
Same fire, same 15-wood pile. But the weather turns ugly and we kept only one useful item.
Stack your wood. I like a tall pile; it's more to scatter.

outro.text: The ship came, but the sea was too high to land. She dropped crates and a promise: spring.

opponent.name: The Autumn Gale
opponent.personality: Loud and wasteful. More book events, more storms, and nothing kept dry for long.

goal.text: Marooned on Harder: Fire and a full 15-wood signal pile in round 10, 11 or 12.

stars.text: Take 8 wounds or fewer in all

easier.text: Standard book events and 2 starting items.

intro.text: No ship till spring. Three stowaway children from the lower deck will find us before then.
Each child eats 1 food a night, and if one goes hungry, we've failed. So: a real home.
Bad crops, barren ground, snow on the roof. Let us see how well you plan for the lean days.

outro.text: A roof, a fence, a full larder, and three small voices arguing over the last fish.
Spring is close. Ada is not. It's time to build a boat.

opponent.name: The Lean Season
opponent.personality: Thrifty and grim. Halves your harvest, turns land to waste and counts every mouth.

twist.text: Season rule: the camp is homesick. Morale starts at -1 instead of 0.

goal.text: Settlers: shelter, roof, palisade and weapon at 1+, and all 9 dealt inventions within 12 rounds.

stars.text: Take 10 wounds or fewer in all
End with 3 or more food in camp

easier.text: Morale starts at 0, standard book events and 2 starting items.

intro.text: Spring storms. Ada is weaker than she was, and the sea around her rock is all teeth.
Rescue Raft first, row out and bring her in, then the Lifeboat. Two wounds a night on that rock.
She is mine already. Every night I take a little more of her.

outro.text: I watched your smoke every day. I knew you would come.
The Lifeboat cleared the reef at dawn. Last entry from the island. We are going home.

opponent.name: The Undertow
opponent.personality: Cold, slow and relentless. Storms knock down your palisade while the clock runs on Ada.
opponent.taunt: The rock is empty now. The sea keeps what it takes.
opponent.praise: A lifeboat with every soul aboard. Go, then. The sea will remember you.

twist.text: Boss rule: Ada has spent a long winter on the rock. She starts with 2 wounds.

goal.text: Stranded Friend: rescue Ada with the Rescue Raft and build the Lifeboat within 8 rounds.

stars.text: Ada has 6 wounds or fewer at the end

easier.text: Ada starts unhurt, standard book events and 2 starting items.
